status: Czech Statistical Office file for the Chamber of Deputies election of 8 and 9 October 2021. The Statistical Office file is the published count. A region is colored only from list votes. Seats are not used. This page does not declare a result.

tables.title: List votes, added across the regions
tables.note: Each party's regional totals added together. Parties under one percent are left off this table. This is the Chamber list vote, not a count of seats.

places.name: Hlavní město Praha
places.summary: SPOLU – ODS, KDU-ČSL, TOP 09 has more list votes than the other parties. A list vote is a vote for that party's candidates in this region. The Statistical Office file has no color code, so the mark is only there to tell parties apart. This site does not declare a result.
